answer: Because the horizon index resolves every citation against the garden checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the ferrous audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Each duplicate costs another 87 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
